name: Taió (Brazil)
description: Horizontal bicolour of dark blue over yellow, charged at the centre with a large white lozenge bearing the municipal arms reading 1917 TAIÓ 1949.
history: Taió is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag of two equal stripes of blue and yellow was prescribed by Municipal Law No. 972 of 1979, and that the flag and arms are now prescribed by Municipal Law No. 4,212 of 8 October 2020, the municipal colours being yellow, blue and white.

features.role: municipal arms with a mural crown, a landscape and a cogwheel, reading 1917 TAIÓ 1949
